_comment: Copy this file, delete the sources you do not use and fill in your own values. Keys that start with an underscore are comments. A source that is listed here runs; set "enabled": false to skip it without deleting it.

pool_notes.anthropic-api: Monthly credit is a budget I chose, not a vendor limit

agy._comment: One entry per account. home gives that account its own HOME so several logins can coexist.

colab._comment: expect_email is optional: when set, 'whoami' must report it or the pool is unknown.

claude_cloud._comment: Unofficial endpoint. The credential is your Claude OAuth token (or the JSON the Claude CLI stores): FLEET_STATUS_CLAUDE_OAUTH_TOKEN, or a command that prints it.

anthropic_ledger._comment: For API users with no Admin key: api_ledger.py record keeps the ledger this reads.
